lineage.description: EM-DAT country profile data for Algeria is derived from the EM-DAT global disaster database maintained by CRED, which compiles disaster impact records from governmental, UN, NGO, insurance, research, and press sources. Raw event-level records are aggregated by year, disaster type, and subtype to produce annual summary statistics including total events, total affected, total deaths, and total economic damage in both original and inflation-adjusted USD. The resulting dataset provides a historical loss time series for Algeria across all recorded natural hazard categories.

sources.description: EM-DAT is a global registry of natural and technological disaster events compiled by CRED, recording total events, deaths, affected populations, and economic damages per disaster type and year. Country profile data for Algeria is aggregated from this registry across all recorded natural hazard disaster types.
